about: LOAD-BUDGET-2530 (T068): the add-on's resource budget, checked by tests/soak/load_budget.py. Written up with the measured numbers in docs/operations/RESOURCE_BUDGET.md (section 'Resource budget 2.53'). A line's 'max' applies to the short run (no device restarts); 'max_with_restarts' to a run with --restarts (the 14 h soak); 'min_window_min' = the line is only judged on a measurement window at least that long.

screens.what: operator screens under the full mix (one request each, as the screen issues it)

polling.what: what wall screens, home panels and TV boards poll all day

writes.what: acknowledge, export create / delete, notice publish / archive

live.what: time to the first media chunk of a live view through the relay (fake go2rtc)

rss_idle_mb.what: backend RSS after the idle phase (device feeds flowing, no clients)

rss_load_max_mb.what: highest backend RSS in the measurement window

rss_growth_mb.what: RSS growth over the window (median of the last 3 samples minus the first 3)

rss_slope_mb_per_h.what: least-squares RSS slope over the window (leak line; long runs only)

py_objects_growth_pct.what: Python object count growth over the window

cpu_avg_pct.what: backend CPU, average over the window

db_growth_mb_per_h.what: database + WAL growth under the mix (retention not reached in a run)

wal_max_mb.what: largest WAL file seen (checkpoints keep it bounded)

fds_max.what: open file descriptors of the backend

sockets_max.what: open sockets of the backend (clients, devices, listeners)

loop_lag_p99_max_ms.what: worst per-sample p99 of the event-loop lag

go2rtc_streams_max.what: streams the backend keeps registered in go2rtc (8 cameras x main / sub)

go2rtc_media_over_viewers.what: go2rtc media sockets beyond the live viewers open at the time

drain_ws_open.what: WebSockets the backend still holds after every client left

drain_live_sessions.what: live sessions left after every viewer left

drain_event_subscribers.what: event-feed subscribers left after every client left

drain_go2rtc_media.what: go2rtc media sockets left after every viewer left

err_4xx_unexpected.what: HTTP 4xx that are not a documented state

db_locked.what: 'database is locked' in the backend log (whole run)

ingest_dropped.what: alerts dropped by the bounded ingest queue (whole run)

live_failed_pct.what: live views that failed to open or were cut

stuck_client_threads.what: client actors that did not stop within 20 s
